main.description: Replace the cast of an open public scene. Service auth must come from the acting member's PDS for the World DID or the World's #motet_tenor service and this exact method. The actor needs the World's current RPC grant. The opener is always retained. The public record and admission rules change atomically. Repeating an operation with the same input returns its original result; reusing its ID for different input is refused.

op.description: A caller-chosen operation ID, unique to this World and actor.

swapRecord.description: The current scene CID. A stale value is refused.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The actor is not authorized to change this World's scene casts.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: The public scene or repository was not found.

errors.name: InvalidSwap
errors.description: The scene record changed since swapRecord.
